Three friends have £65 all together. Mark gets £5 more than Lea. Lea has half as much money as Steven. Steven has £30.

Question: How much money do each of the friends have?

Four friends have £100 all together. Luke has £4 less than Carla. Carla has £2 more than Paul. Lisa has twice as much money as Paul. Paul has £20.

Question: How much money do each of the friends have?

There are 100 people in the museum at 1pm. Every hour, 30 new visitors come to the exhibition and 15 visitors leave.

How many visitors will be in the museum at 3pm?

A hedge always grows exactly 6 cm every 12 months. On the 1st of May every year, the hedge gets cut 2 cm shorter. Today is the 1st of May and the hedge is cut to 160 cm tall.

How tall will the hedge be on the 2nd of May in two years’ time?
